narrative.intro: Medline Industries has $895M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries won 726 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $1.2M, and obligations are up 54.6% year over year. Medline Industries received most of its federal business from the Department of Veterans Affairs, which accounted for $850M of obligations in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries sells mainly through the Medical, Dental, and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers market, which accounts for $857M of FY2026 to date obligations, followed by Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing at $37.9M. Medline Industries shows additional NAICS entries including In-Vitro Diagnostic Substance Manufacturing at $173K, Medicinal and Botanical Manufacturing at $165K, and Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing at $16.8K. Fiscal-year trends show steady growth from FY21 through FY26, with obligations of $262M in FY21, $281M in FY22, $337M in FY23, $370M in FY24, $579M in FY25, and $895M in FY26.

sections.heading: Who are Medline Industries' biggest federal customers?
sections.body: The Department of Veterans Affairs is Medline Industries' largest federal customer at $850M in FY2026 to date. The Department of Health and Human Services follows at $33M, with the Department of Justice at $10.9M. The Department of the Treasury, Department of Defense, and Department of the Interior account for $250K, $186K, and $154K respectively.

sections.heading: What product markets drive Medline Industries' federal sales?
sections.body: Medical, Dental, and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers is Medline Industries' dominant market at $857M in FY2026 to date. Surgical and Medical Instrument Manufacturing is the next-largest market at $37.9M. Medline Industries also records activity in In-Vitro Diagnostic Substance Manufacturing, Medicinal and Botanical Manufacturing, and Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing at $173K, $165K, and $16.8K respectively.

faq.q: How much does Medline Industries make from federal contracts?
faq.a: Medline Industries has $895M in federal contract obligations in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries recorded 726 awards this fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $1.2M, and obligations are up 54.6% year over year.

faq.q: Which agencies buy from Medline Industries?
faq.a: The Department of Veterans Affairs is Medline Industries' largest federal buyer at $850M in FY2026 to date. The Department of Health and Human Services accounts for $33M, and the Department of Justice accounts for $10.9M; smaller buying agencies include the Department of the Treasury at $250K, the Department of Defense at $186K, and the Department of the Interior at $154K.

faq.q: What does Medline Industries sell to the government?
faq.a: Medline Industries primarily sells medical and hospital supplies through the Medical, Dental, and Hospital Equipment and Supplies Merchant Wholesalers market, which accounts for $857M in FY2026 to date. Medline Industries also sells surgical and medical instruments, which account for $37.9M, with additional activity in In-Vitro Diagnostic Substance Manufacturing ($173K), Medicinal and Botanical Manufacturing ($165K), and Analytical Laboratory Instrument Manufacturing ($16.8K).
